node.label: Chess
node.summary: World Championship, Candidates and Indian players.

facts.text: Indian GM **V. Pranav** (20, Chennai) won the Open title at the FIDE World Junior Blitz Championship in Al Ain (10.5/13 points), having already won the World Junior Classical title; he also took rapid silver at the same event.
facts.plain: Indian GM V. Pranav (20, Chennai) won the Open title at the FIDE World Junior Blitz Championship in Al Ain (10.5/13 points), having already won the World Junior Classical title; he also took rapid silver at the same event.

facts.text: Turkey's **Yagiz Kaan Erdogmus** (15, rated 2731) played the **Tech Mahindra Global Chess League** in Bengaluru for PBG Alaskan Knights; he was the 4th youngest GM in history.

facts.text: **D. Gukesh** became the youngest undisputed world champion at **18** by beating **Ding Liren** in Singapore in **Dec 2024**. World's youngest GM ever: **Abhimanyu Mishra** (USA).
facts.plain: D. Gukesh became the youngest undisputed world champion at 18 by beating Ding Liren in Singapore in Dec 2024. World's youngest GM ever: Abhimanyu Mishra (USA).

facts.text: **Javokhir Sindarov** (Uzbekistan) won the **Candidates** and will challenge **D. Gukesh** for the World Chess Championship in **Geneva** in November.
